target_customer: Startup and mid-market B2B GTM teams and sales leaders wanting precision outbound without hiring a GTM engineer
problem: Precision outbound needs 10 plus stitched tools and a GTM engineer; spray and pray outbound no longer works.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI revenue agents

founders.name: Devi Jha
previous_startups: Leafpress, energy software, YC S23, acquired by Johnson Controls

founders.name: Jianna Liu
previous_startups: Leafpress, energy software, YC S23, acquired by Johnson Controls

competitors.name: Clay
competitors.what: GTM engineering and data orchestration platform that outbound teams stitch workflows in

competitors.name: Artisan
competitors.what: AI-operated GTM platform pitched as removing the GTM engineer

competitors.name: Apollo
competitors.what: Sales engagement and data platform adding AI features

technical_complexity.rationale: Agent workflows over signals, enrichment and email deliverability with a custom sequencer are standard engineering with some hard parts such as deliverability.

defensibility.rationale: Learning from replies and CRM integrations create some stickiness, but many funded AI SDR and GTM agent products overlap.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent tools were adding agents by 2026; no outcome recorded yet for Cardinal.

market_need_then: Outbound teams struggle with tool sprawl and the cost of GTM engineers; founders report their prior company won customers via cold outbound, and the company claims results such as $2M pipeline for a customer (self published).

branding.domain_note: Uses trycardinal.com; the site states it is not affiliated with Cardinal Health

identity.voice_and_tone: Agents as teammates, not tools; slogan 'Go to market? Go to Cardinal.'

branding.brand_signature: Slogan 'Go to market? Go to Cardinal.'

brand_strength.rationale: Brand search returned only Cardinal Health material; the name is confusable with many Cardinals and the site needs a disclaimer.

pivots.why: not stated; reported by RuntimeWire as a pivot before the February 2026 launch

outcome_analysis: Cardinal is an active Winter 2026 company from two founders who sold Leafpress to Johnson Controls and returned to YC. It pivoted from document intelligence to AI revenue agents and launched publicly in February 2026 with self reported customer wins, but the space is crowded and funding is not verified.
notes: Unverified funding: Neuronfeed lists $500K seed led by YC (January 2026); a job posting reportedly says over $5M raised with Audacious Ventures and Burst Capital, but it was not opened. No round recorded. Pivot detail comes from a RuntimeWire headline seen in search results, not opened. Founded year not stated. Team size shows 0 in the directory.
